en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Ubeyda Al Haza’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is that the false oath, and the cutting-off of relationships both devastate the houses to be deserted from its inhabitants, and locks the wombs, meaning the cutting-off of the lineage’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from abu ‘Ubaydah al- Hadhdha’ who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
it is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that false oath and cutting off of good relations with relatives leave a town barren, empty of its inhabitants and destroys the reproducing continuum.’”
